images.filename: StateLibQld 1 235426 View from Queen's Hotel, looking up the hill, Townsville, ca. 1881.jpg
images.caption:
View from Queen's Hotel, looking up the hill, Townsville, ca. 1881.
Bank of New South Wales building is in the centre foreground and two large buildings are pictured centre left. There are several homes scattered up the hill and an unsealed road forms the street.

images.filename: StateLibQld 2 184115 Storm damaged buildings in Townsville following Cyclone 'Leonta' in 1903.jpg
images.caption:
Storm damaged buildings in Townsville following Cyclone 'Leonta' in 1903.
Cyclone 'Leonta' struck Townsville on the 9th March, 1903. This view shows the hospital grounds from Stanton Hill. In the background is the Queens Park Hotel [2 storeys] unroofed and two adjoining shops which have been demolished [Allen and Sons Properties]. [Description supplied with photograph].
